pages.title: Chemistry Guide
pages.text: Everything Education Edition brings to Java, one page at a time.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.text: Welcome! This book has every recipe in the mod, and how to use the tables, chalkboards, NPCs and cameras. The bookmarks on the right jump to each chapter.

pages.title: Turning It On
pages.text:
Education Edition is a world setting: turn it on in the Game tab when you create a world.

For an existing world:
/gamerule edu:education_features true

With it off, nothing from the mod works.

pages.title: Using This Book
pages.text:
Hover over any item to see its name. The number on an item is how many you need.

Turn pages with the arrows, the scroll wheel or Page Up / Page Down. Home goes back to the Contents.

The book opens where you left off.

pages.title: The Creative Tab
pages.text: Everything is in the Education Edition creative tab. The side tabs split it into Education, Lab Equipment, Elements, Compounds and Products.

pages.title: This Book
pages.text: A book and a glass bottle. Unlocked by picking up a book.

pages.title: Lab Equipment
pages.text: Four tables do the chemistry: the Element Constructor, the Compound Creator, the Lab Table and the Material Reducer.

pages.title: Element Constructor
pages.text: Makes any of the 118 elements. Unlocked by amethyst or redstone.

pages.title: Using the Constructor
pages.text:
Drag the three sliders to set the protons, electrons and neutrons. The protons decide the element, and the picture shows the atom as you build it.

When it makes a real element, take it from the output slot.

pages.title: Compound Creator
pages.text: Joins elements into compounds. Unlocked by a cauldron or redstone.

pages.title: Using the Creator
pages.text:
Put the elements in the grid in the right amounts. If they make a compound, it appears in the output slot.

The recipe book button shows every compound you have unlocked and can fill the grid for you.

pages.title: Lab Table
pages.text: Reacts elements and compounds. Unlocked by a glass bottle.

pages.title: Using the Lab Table
pages.text: Put the ingredients on the table and press Combine. A known reaction makes its product; anything else fizzles, smokes or bangs (harmlessly) and leaves Garbage.

pages.title: Material Reducer
pages.text: Breaks blocks and compounds down into their elements. It has no crafting recipe: find it in the Creative inventory, or buy one from a Master Chemist.

pages.title: Chemist Villager
pages.text: A jobless villager who finds a Lab Table becomes a Chemist. Look for their labs in villages. They sell elements and products; Masters sell the Material Reducer.

pages.title: Elements
pages.text: Each element has its own number of protons: its atomic number. Make them in the Element Constructor, or get them from blocks with the Material Reducer.

pages.title: Making Carbon
pages.subtitle: 6 protons, 6 neutrons, 6 electrons
pages.text: Set the sliders to these numbers, then take the Carbon. The protons pick the element.

pages.title: Making Oxygen
pages.subtitle: 8 protons, 8 neutrons, 8 electrons
pages.text: Lots of compounds need oxygen, so make plenty.

pages.title: Isotopes
pages.text:
Change the number of neutrons and you get an isotope: the same element with a different mass. Carbon with 8 neutrons is Carbon-14.

The number of electrons should match the protons to make a neutral atom.

pages.title: Reducing Sand
pages.text: Most natural blocks break down into the elements they're made of.

pages.title: Reducing Dirt
pages.text: Gives the elements the block is made of.

pages.title: Compounds
pages.text: Put the right elements, in the right amounts, into the Compound Creator. Each page shows the formula and what the compound is for.

pages.title: Lab Table
pages.text:
Put ingredients on the Lab Table and press Combine.

Medicines can also be brewed: an Awkward Potion plus one element.

pages.title: Bleach
pages.text: Turns coloured wool, carpets, beds, banners, bundles, harnesses and leather armour white.

pages.title: Ice Bomb
pages.text: Throw it: it freezes the water where it lands.

pages.title: Super Fertilizer
pages.text: Like bone meal, but one use fully grows a sapling or crop.

pages.title: Heat Block
pages.text: Melts snow and ice within 2 blocks, without giving off light.

pages.title: Magnesium Salts
pages.text: A compound you can only make at the Lab Table.

pages.title: Elephant Toothpaste
pages.text: A big foamy reaction! It leaves Garbage behind.

pages.title: Antidote
pages.text: Cures poison. Also brewed: Awkward Potion + Silver.

pages.title: Elixir
pages.text: Cures weakness. Also brewed: Awkward Potion + Cobalt.

pages.title: Eye Drops
pages.text: Cures blindness. Also brewed: Awkward Potion + Calcium.

pages.title: Tonic
pages.text: Cures nausea. Also brewed: Awkward Potion + Bismuth.

pages.title: Products
pages.text: Made on a normal Crafting Table. Coloured things are shown in one colour: swap the coloured ingredient for another colour.

pages.title: Hardened Glass
pages.text: Makes 3. As tough as obsidian against explosions.

pages.title: Hardened Glass Pane
pages.text: Makes 3.

pages.title: Hardened Stained Glass
pages.text: Makes 3. Shown in red: any colour of stained glass works.

pages.title: Hardened Stained Glass Pane
pages.text: Makes 3. Shown in red: any colour of pane works.

pages.title: Colored Torch
pages.text: Shown in red. The chloride picks the colour: see the next page.

pages.title: Chloride Colours
pages.text:
Each chloride burns its own colour:

Cerium Chloride: blue
Mercuric Chloride: red
Potassium Chloride: purple
Tungsten Chloride: green
Calcium Chloride: orange (sparklers only)

pages.title: Underwater Torch
pages.text: Magnesium over a torch. Stays lit under water.

pages.title: Underwater TNT
pages.text: Sodium over TNT. Unlike normal TNT, it still breaks blocks under water.

pages.title: Sparkler
pages.text: Shown in red. The chloride picks the colour (see Chloride Colours).

pages.title: Glow Stick
pages.text: Shown in red: any dye but light gray or black works. Hold use to shake it.

pages.title: Balloon
pages.text: Shown in red: use any dye for that colour.

pages.title: Flying Balloons
pages.text:
Use a balloon on a fence or a mob to tie it on. Light mobs float away with it; heavy ones stay put.

Punch it to push it (and its mob). Right-click it or the fence to untie it. Ceilings and arrows pop it.

pages.title: Bleaching
pages.text: Also whitens carpets, beds, banners, bundles, harnesses and leather armour.

pages.title: Classroom
pages.text: Tools for building lessons and adventure maps: chalkboards, permission blocks, World Builder, NPCs, the Agent and Code Builder, and the Camera and Portfolio.

pages.title: Slate
pages.text: A small chalkboard (1x1). Any kind of planks works (shown with spruce).

pages.title: Poster
pages.text: Two Slates side by side make a Poster (2x1).

pages.title: Board
pages.text: Two Posters, one above the other, make a Board (3x2).

pages.title: Chalkboards
pages.text:
Place a chalkboard on a wall, or on the floor to stand it on legs. Use it to write.

World Builders can lock a chalkboard so only they can edit it. Ones they place can only be broken by World Builders.

pages.title: Permission Blocks
pages.text:
Allow: anyone can build above it.
Deny: no one can build above it.
Border: no one can pass its column.
World Builders ignore all three.

pages.title: World Builder
pages.text:
World Builders can build anywhere and edit NPCs and locked chalkboards.

/wb gives or takes it. Only the world's host can use it, in chat or in command blocks; players who join can't.

pages.title: Immutable World
pages.text: Turn on the edu:immutable_world gamerule and only World Builders can change the world, except above Allow blocks.

pages.title: NPCs
pages.text: World Builders place them with the spawn egg and give them a skin, dialogue and buttons that run commands. Anyone can talk to them.

pages.title: The Agent
pages.text: A robot that follows your /agent commands, one block at a time. Get yours with its spawn egg or /agent create (everyone has one). Right-click it for its inventory.

pages.title: Agent Commands
pages.text:
/agent move, destroy, place, till, attack and dropall take a direction: forward, back, left, right, up or down. /agent turn left or right.

Place and drop take a slot (1-27) first. /agent collect all picks up items nearby.

pages.title: Asking the Agent
pages.text:
/agent detect, inspect and inspectdata check the block in a direction. getitemcount, getitemspace and getitemdetail check a slot. getposition says where it is.

In command blocks, run them with /execute as a player.

pages.title: Code Builder
pages.text:
Press C to open MakeCode in your web browser, linked to this world (it needs the internet). Code with blocks, JavaScript or Python, then press Run.

Programs can move the Agent, build and answer chat commands.

pages.title: Camera
pages.text: Any kind of planks works (shown with spruce).

pages.title: Taking Pictures
pages.text:
Place the Camera to set up its tripod, then click it: it turns to face you, flashes, and takes your picture.

Sneak and use the Camera in your hand to take a close-up of what you are looking at.

pages.title: Portfolio
pages.text: A book and a piece of paper. Keeps every picture you take, with captions, and can export them as a PDF.
